name: Nagoya (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the maru-hachi (circled eight) emblem in red: the kanji 八 within a ring.
history: The maru-hachi mark, taken from the crest of the Owari Tokugawa house, was adopted as Nagoya's city emblem in 1907; the white flag bearing it in red followed in 1950.

features.role: maru-hachi — the kanji 八 in a circle
features.symbolism: the historic crest of the Owari Tokugawa branch that ruled Nagoya Castle, adopted as the city emblem in 1907
